metadata.name: BillPayRecurringEntireSeriesPayment
metadata.description: Use this API to update the entire recurring payment series.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: SubscriberID
request_fields.description: This is the Service Provider's (iPay Solutions) identifier  for the Cardholder User. Example : 12345678

request_fields.name: PaymentId
request_fields.description: This is the payment ID which is generated by Bill Payment Services. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 120 Note : PaymentID will be generated for only recurring payments.

request_fields.name: PayeeId
request_fields.description: This is the Payee identifier associated with the Payee or Transfer account for the Bill Pay Services API. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 120

request_fields.name: PaymentFrequencyType
request_fields.description: This is the payment frequency for the recurring payment or recurring Transfer series at the time the payment/Transfer was processed. Valid Values: i)   Weekly - Weekly ii)  TwiceMonthly - Twice Monthly iii) Monthly - Monthly iv)  Every3Months - Quarterly v)   Every6Months - Half Yearly vi)  Annual - Annually Example: Weekly, TwiceMonthly, Every3Months, Every6Months, Annual. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PaymentDayOfWeek
request_fields.description: This is the specified day of the week when recurring payments or Transfers will be made if the specified payment frequency is: ‘Weekly’. Valid values: Mon,Tues,Wed,Thur, Fri Example: Wed Condition: This shall be the mandatory field when PaymentFrequencyType=Weekly. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: PaymentDayofMonth
request_fields.description: This is the day of the month when the recurring payment or Transfer will be made .The Value 'LastBusinessDay' shall not be applicable when PaymentFrequencyType is set as TwiceMonthly. Valid Values: 1 - 31 Example: 15 Condition: i: The Value 'LastBusinessDay' shall not be applicable when PaymentFrequencyType is set as TwiceMonthly. ii: This shall be the mandatory field when PaymentFrequencyType = MOnthly, TwiceMonthly.

request_fields.name: PaymentDayofMonthTo
request_fields.description: This is the second day of the month when the recurring payment or Transfer will be made. Valid Values: 1 - 31. Example: 28 Condition: i.This shall be the mandatory field and will be applicable only when PaymentFrequencyType is set as TwiceMonthly. ii.This day value should be greater than 6 days with the day set in DayoftheMonth tag.

request_fields.name: PaymentUseLastBusDay
request_fields.description: This is the payment or Transfer should be made on the last business day of the month. Valid Values: true, false. Example:  true, false. Condition: This value can be set when the PaymentFrequencyType=TwiceMonthly, Monthly, Every3Months,Every6Months, Annual.

request_fields.name: PaymentUseLastBusDayTo
request_fields.description: This indicates that the payment or Transfer should be made on the last business day of the month. Valid Values: true, false. Example: true, false. Condition: This value can be set when the PaymentFrequencyType=TwiceMonthly

request_fields.name: PaymentInstruction
request_fields.description: This is the payment date instruction when a recurring payment or Transfer date falls on a non-processing date (such as a weekend or holiday). Valid Values: Before, After. Example:  Before, After. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: PaymentOccurance
request_fields.description: This is the number of remaining payment or Transfer occurrences for the recurring payment or recurring Transfer series at the time the specified payment or Transfer was processed. Valid Values: 1-9999. Example: 20

request_fields.name: PaymentSeriesExpireDate
request_fields.description: This is the expiration date for the recurring payment or Transfer series. Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example :2015-12-11T00:00:00 Condition: This field is mandatory when thePaymentSeriesFinite is set as True.

request_fields.name: PaymentSeriesFinite
request_fields.description: This indicates whether the payment or Transfer series is finite or ‘has no end’. Valid Values: true, false.(default) Example: true, false.

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: This is the amount for which one time payment shall get initiated for the Payee. Example:10.02

request_fields.name: PaymentProcessDate
request_fields.description: This is the date when the BillpaymentSource(IPAY) initiated the payment to the subscriber system. Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00 Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

request_fields.name: PaymentDate
request_fields.description: This is the date when the payment get posted to Payee. Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00 Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

request_fields.name: ActivationIntentKey
request_fields.description: This is the Activation key is used to Update/Delete the Payee Example: B6F8CC9B-7BFC-469B-BD4C-2CA520FA0A9F Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: Memo
request_fields.description: This is the memo to be added to a check associated with a check payment. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: PaymentComment
request_fields.description: This is the comment that will be stored with the payment. Allowable Values: 300

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.
